description: This file defines the UserStore class implementing various ASP.NET Core Identity store interfaces for user management, including creation, deletion, role management, claims, tokens, lockout, two-factor authentication, and phone number handling within the OrchardCore project.

classes.name: UserStore
classes.description: Implements user store interfaces for user management, including claims, roles, passwords, email, security stamps, logins, lockout, two-factor authentication, tokens, and phone numbers within OrchardCore.

methods.name: NormalizeKey
methods.description: Normalizes a user key using the configured normalizer.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new user, ensuring a unique user ID, invoking creation handlers, and saving to the session.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a user, invoking deletion handlers and removing from session.

methods.name: FindByIdAsync
methods.description: Finds a user by user ID.

methods.name: FindByNameAsync
methods.description: Finds a user by normalized username.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates user information, invoking updating and updated handlers.

methods.name: HasPasswordAsync
methods.description: Checks if the user has a password.

methods.name: FindByEmailAsync
methods.description: Finds a user by normalized email.

methods.name: GetRolesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves roles assigned to a user.

methods.name: IsInRoleAsync
methods.description: Checks if user is in a role.

methods.name: GetUsersInRoleAsync
methods.description: Retrieves users in a specific role.

methods.name: AddLoginAsync
methods.description: Links a login to a user.

methods.name: FindByLoginAsync
methods.description: Finds a user by login provider and key.

methods.name: GetLoginsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves login info for a user.

methods.name: RemoveLoginAsync
methods.description: Removes a login from a user.

methods.name: ReplaceClaimAsync
methods.description: Replaces a claim for a user.

methods.name: GetUsersForClaimAsync
methods.description: Finds users with a specific claim.

methods.name: GetTokenAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user token, decrypting it.

methods.name: SetTokenAsync
methods.description: Sets a user token, encrypting it.

methods.name: GetUserToken
methods.description: Helper to get a specific user token.

methods.name: GetAccessFailedCountAsync
methods.description: Gets the count of failed access attempts.

methods.name: GetPhoneNumberConfirmedAsync
methods.description: Checks if phone number is confirmed.
